name: Ukraine
description: Follow Ukraine, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Russia blasts Zaporizhzhia with glide bombs while Ukrainian drones kill 9
changes.summary: Russian planes have dropped powerful glide bombs on Zaporizhzhia, Ukraine, killing one person and wounding dozens. Meanwhile, Ukrainian drone debris killed six people in Arkhipo-Osipovka in Russia.

changes.title: News Wrap: Michigan reports 2 deaths related to cyclosporiasis outbreak
changes.summary: In our news wrap Monday, health officials in Michigan reported the first deaths in the U.S. related to a cyclosporiasis outbreak, more than two dozen states are suing the Trump administration over its latest tariffs and officials in southern Ukraine say Russia dropped eight glide bombs in a span of 90 minutes, killing.

changes.title: 'Winter is coming': Ukraine fears its toughest test since Russia's full-scale invasion
changes.summary: Russian forces have ramped up the number of missile strikes on Ukrainian cities, likely seeking to exploit Kyiv's shortage of ballistic missile interceptors.

changes.title: Fact-Checking Trump’s Claims About the Effect of the Iran War on Oil Prices, Munitions and More
changes.summary: The president misleadingly blamed the Biden administration’s weapons transfers to Ukraine for current concerns over munitions stockpiles, among other claims about the Iran war.

changes.title: How Ukraine Is Making Inroads With MAGA and a Trump Ally, Laura Loomer
changes.summary: Ukraine and its supporters have invested years in trying to undo the skepticism of the country’s war effort harbored by President Trump’s MAGA movement and the president himself.

changes.title: Overnight Russian barrage kills nine in Kyiv, as air defense struggle with U.S. continues
changes.summary: Ballistic missiles tore into five districts of the Ukrainian capital before dawn Saturday. President Trump is now walking back a promised boost to Ukraine's missile defense systems. (Image credit: Dan Bashakov).

changes.title: Trump Backs Away From Deal to Let Ukraine Build Patriot Missiles
changes.summary: The president of Ukraine had warned that the country was running out of Patriot interceptors, the most reliable weapon it has to shoot down Russian ballistic missiles.

changes.title: Russian strikes on Kyiv kill 9, injure at least 27, officials say
changes.summary: Kyiv said the strikes had killed four people, and the city's mayor reported 15 people, including two boys aged 13 and 17, were wounded and transported to hospital.

changes.title: Russian Missiles Kill 9 in Kyiv After Trump Backs Off Air-Defense Pledge
changes.summary: Ukraine’s supply of Patriot missile interceptors is dwindling, and on Friday, President Trump backed away from his promise to let Ukraine make them itself.

changes.title: Russian strikes on Kyiv kill 9, injure at least 15, officials say
changes.summary: Kyiv said the strikes had killed four people, and the city's mayor reported 15 people, including two boys aged 13 and 17, were wounded and transported to hospital.
